title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. In the first face, draw the first loop consisting of six lines. Start by drawing the first line from the point (0.0, 0.3627) to (0.5863, 0.0), then draw the second line from (0.5863, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.4013), followed by the third line from (0.75, 0.4013) to (0.6086, 0.394). Continue with the fourth line from (0.6086, 0.394) to (0.5061, 0.2118), the fifth line from (0.5061, 0.2118) to (0.1768, 0.3718), and finally, the sixth line from (0.1768, 0.3718) back to the starting point (0.0, 0.3627). After completing the first loop, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Rotate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it using the same translation vector. Extrude the sketch 0.0066 units in the direction of the normal to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the part are a length of 0.7499999991467733 units, a width of 0.40132814273799466 units, and a height of 0.006628857096486276 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the points for the sketch
points = [
    (0.0, 0.3627),
    (0.5863, 0.0),
    (0.75, 0.4013),
    (0.6086, 0.394),
    (0.5061, 0.2118),
    (0.1768, 0.3718),
    (0.0, 0.3627)
]

# Create the sketch
r = r.polyline(points).close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0066)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

    (0.181, 0.370),   # upper-left edge point
    (0.511, 0.213),   # inner valley
    (0.616, 0.390),   # right peak
    (0.750, 0.400),   # far right tip

]

    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .polyline(pts)
    .close()
